verses.translation: When God’s help comes and He opens up your way [Prophet],

verses.text_uthmani: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا
verses.translation: when you see people embracing God’s faith in crowds,

verses.text_uthmani: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
verses.translation: celebrate the praise of your Lord and ask His forgiveness: He is always ready to accept repentance.
